summary: Completed live frontend and backend verification for the Bali wedding invitation. All executed API tests and core UI flows passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Invitation Guest through API and TEST UI Guest / TEST UI Guest 2 through the wishes form; the app has no delete endpoint, so these test wishes remain persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Covered cover/guest flow, hero/date/countdown, event schedule/maps, gallery lightbox, copy link, WhatsApp share URL, wishes persistence/rendering, music URL persistence/control presence, and mobile overflow. No auth or mocked integrations are present.
rca of the issue: No product issue reproduced. One initial UI assertion used title case against intentionally uppercase event-label styling, and one WhatsApp assertion expected wa.me while the browser correctly followed the provider redirect to api.whatsapp.com; both were test-harness assumptions rather than application failures.
